outlets.name: The New York Times (Restaurant List — "25 Best Restaurants in Washington, DC, Right Now" / "50 Best New Restaurants in America")
outlets.credible: National paper of record; its critic-curated DC/best-new lists are a genuine institutional authority and were used only as one of multiple corroborating credible sources (Baan Siam, Daru). Not Yelp/TripAdvisor. Direct NYT URLs are paywalled here; the Baan Siam citation points to the Mount Vernon Triangle CID repost of the NYT list.

outlets.name: Southern Foodways Alliance (SFA) — food-culture nonprofit / oral-history journal
outlets.credible: University of Mississippi-affiliated documentary nonprofit; long-form, edited food-culture pieces (used for Purple Patch's diaspora story). Editorial and authoritative, not a listicle or ratings platform. Corroborates the Washington Post's Restaurant-of-the-Year honor.

outlets.name: Resy — "Right This Way" editorial
outlets.credible: Resy's edited editorial arm publishes reported chef/restaurant features (Supra, Daru, Kayu, Chang Chang encountered here). Used only as supporting color, never as a lone recommender; kept out of the two-credible count where a place's gate rests on stronger authorities.

outlets.name: Esquire — Best New Restaurants in America
outlets.credible: National magazine; its annual Best New Restaurants list named Chang Chang (2023). Referenced in write-ups as corroborating acclaim, not counted as a lone recommender.
